test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

This certainly was a __feeble__ attempt to capture the culprit.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Powerful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined word **"Feeble"** means weak in a way that lacks strength or effectiveness. It often refers to something that is noticeably lacking in effectiveness or vigor. (कमजोर)

 
 
• **Example: **His argument against the case was feeble and didn't convince the jury.</li
